name: Dtwo
description:
Dtwo is a security control plane for AI agents. This server exposes all of it: stand up an MCP gateway, connect your MCP servers, then write, test, and deploy policies — all without leaving your agent.

You don't have to start from scratch. The open policy catalog has ready-made policies for common systems like Slack, Jira, Salesforce and Snowflake, bundled by compliance framework.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Dtwo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Dtwo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.us1.prod.dtwo.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Dtwo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dtwo lists 56 MCP tools, including dtwo-add-intent-transition, dtwo-add-policy, dtwo-apply-catalog-policy-update, dtwo-check-policy-updates, dtwo-create-gateway, dtwo-create-intent, dtwo-create-intent-compatibility, dtwo-create-marker, dtwo-delete-intent, dtwo-delete-intent-compatibility, dtwo-delete-intent-transition, and dtwo-delete-marker.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Dtwo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Dtwo in other on the Manufact MCP catalog include Muju, ZMAXINC, PGA – Play Golf, citytracker.ai, and Commonlands Optics: M12 Lens and C-Mount Lens Finder + Field-of-View Calculator.
Dtwo requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Dtwo is developed by DTwo, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
